source_refs.note: Exercise 6.2, Question 1 (a)-(b): tangent and normal to a circle at a given point; book p. 182, answers p. 305 (PDF 307)

blocks.prompt: 1 (a) Find the equations of the tangent and normal to the circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 8\) at \((2, 2)\) and at \((2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta, 2\sqrt{2}\sin\theta)\).
blocks.explanation:
Circle ka centre origin par hai aur diye gaye points circle par hain, to 6.2.1 aur 6.2.3 ke tayyar formulas seedha lagenge.
Diya kya hai? \(x^2 + y^2 = 8\), points \((2, 2)\) aur \((2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta, 2\sqrt{2}\sin\theta)\).
Find kya karna hai? Har point par tangent (circle ko chhoone wali line) aur normal (tangent par perpendicular line).
Rule kaunsa? Tangent \(xx_1 + yy_1 = r^2\), normal \(xy_1 - yx_1 = 0\).
Plan: pehle check karo ke point circle par hai, phir values rakh do.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2 + y^2 = 8\), yani \(r^2 = 8\); points \((2, 2)\) aur \((2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta, 2\sqrt{2}\sin\theta)\).
Maloom karna: dono points par tangent aur normal.
Tareeqa: \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) ke point \((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent \(xx_1 + yy_1 = r^2\) (6.2.1) aur normal \(xy_1 - yx_1 = 0\) (6.2.3). Normal hamesha centre (yahan origin) se guzarta hai.

Check karein ke \((2, 2)\) circle par hai
\[2^2 + 2^2 = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh formulas sirf circle par pade point ke liye sahi hain. Agar point bahar hota to yeh tangent ki equation nahi balke kuch aur (chord of contact) ban jati.

\((2, 2)\) par tangent
\[2x + 2y = 8\]
\[x + y - 4 = 0\]
Kyun: \(x^2 \to xx_1\), \(y^2 \to yy_1\) wala rule: \(x(2) + y(2) = 8\). Phir 2 se divide.

\((2, 2)\) par normal
\[2x - 2y = 0\]
\[x - y = 0\]
Kyun: \(xy_1 - yx_1 = 0\) mein \(x_1 = y_1 = 2\). Yeh line origin (centre) se guzarti hai, jaisa normal ko guzarna chahiye.

Doosra point bhi circle par hai
\[(2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta)^2 + (2\sqrt{2}\sin\theta)^2\]
\[= 8(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta) = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh parametric point \((r\cos\theta, r\sin\theta)\) hai jahan \(r = 2\sqrt{2}\); \((2\sqrt{2})^2 = 8\).

Is point par tangent
\[2\sqrt{2}\,x\cos\theta + 2\sqrt{2}\,y\sin\theta = 8\]
\[x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = 2\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: \(x_1 = 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta\), \(y_1 = 2\sqrt{2}\sin\theta\) rakhe, phir \(2\sqrt{2}\) se divide: \(\frac{8}{2\sqrt{2}} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{2}} = 2\sqrt{2}\).
Dhyan dein: Right side bhi divide karni hai; \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = 8\) likhna ghalat hai.

Isi point par normal
\[2\sqrt{2}\,x\sin\theta - 2\sqrt{2}\,y\cos\theta = 0\]
\[x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta = 0\]
Kyun: \(xy_1 - yx_1 = 0\): \(x\) ke saath \(y_1\) (sin wala) aur \(y\) ke saath \(x_1\) (cos wala). Phir common \(2\sqrt{2}\) se divide.

Tasdeeq
\[\theta = \tfrac{\pi}{4}:\ \tfrac{x}{\sqrt{2}} + \tfrac{y}{\sqrt{2}} = 2\sqrt{2}\]
\[\Rightarrow x + y = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{4}\) par point \((2, 2)\) ban jata hai, aur general jawab pehle wala jawab de deta hai. Saath hi tangent ka slope \(-1\) aur normal ka 1, product \(-1\): perpendicular.
blocks.final_answer: \((2, 2)\) par: tangent \(x + y = 4\), normal \(x - y = 0\). \((2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta, 2\sqrt{2}\sin\theta)\) par: tangent \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = 2\sqrt{2}\), normal \(x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta = 0\).

blocks.prompt: 1 (b) Find the equations of the tangent and normal to the circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 6x - 2y - 7 = 0\) at \((4, 5)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh general circle hai (centre origin par nahi), aur point circle par hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x^2 + y^2 - 6x - 2y - 7 = 0\) aur point \((4, 5)\).
Find kya karna hai? Is point par tangent aur normal.
Rule kaunsa? 6.2.2 ka substitution rule tangent ke liye; normal woh line jo point aur centre dono se guzre.
Plan: point check karo, \(g, f, c\) parho, rule lagao, phir centre se normal.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2 + y^2 - 6x - 2y - 7 = 0\); point \((4, 5)\).
Maloom karna: \((4, 5)\) par tangent aur normal.
Tareeqa: Tangent \(xx_1 + yy_1 + g(x + x_1) + f(y + y_1) + c = 0\) (6.2.2). Normal centre \((-g, -f)\) se guzarta hai, is liye do points wali line ban jati hai.

Point check karein aur \(g, f, c\) parhein
\[16 + 25 - 24 - 10 - 7 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[g = -3,\ f = -1,\ c = -7\]
Kyun: Rule sirf circle ke point par chalta hai. \(2g = -6\) se \(g = -3\), \(2f = -2\) se \(f = -1\). Is tarah centre \((-g, -f) = (3, 1)\) bhi saath hi mil gaya, jo normal ke liye kaam aayega.

\((4, 5)\) par tangent
\[4x + 5y - 3(x + 4) - (y + 5) - 7 = 0\]
\[x + 4y - 24 = 0\]
Kyun: Rule: \(x^2 \to xx_1 = 4x\), \(y^2 \to yy_1 = 5y\), \(-6x = 2g\,x \to g(x + x_1) = -3(x + 4)\), \(-2y \to -(y + 5)\), constant waisa hi. Phir: \(4x - 3x = x\), \(5y - y = 4y\), \(-12 - 5 - 7 = -24\).
Dhyan dein: \(-6x\) ko \(-6\left(\frac{x + 4}{2}\right) = -3(x + 4)\) banana hai; poora \(-6(x + 4)\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Normal: \((4, 5)\) aur centre \((3, 1)\) se
\[m = \dfrac{5 - 1}{4 - 3} = 4\]
\[y - 5 = 4(x - 4)\]
\[4x - y - 11 = 0\]
Kyun: Circle ka normal hamesha centre se guzarta hai (radius hi normal ki direction mein hai). Do points se slope nikala aur point-slope form lagaya.

Tasdeeq
\[m_T = -\tfrac{1}{4},\quad m_N = 4\]
\[m_T \cdot m_N = -1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tangent aur normal perpendicular hain. Aur \((4, 5)\) dono par pada hai: \(4 + 20 - 24 = 0\), \(16 - 5 - 11 = 0\).
